_method: Adjudication of the 36 held-out review-queue rows (heldout_yt.review.jsonl) that the automatic silver-consensus threshold rejected. Rule: accept when at least two providers agree on CONTENT (script and loanword-spelling differences ignored, per the benchmark's script-agnostic metric); the reference is the medoid hypothesis verbatim, overridden to the other content-agreeing hypothesis only where the medoid contains a demonstrable mishear (checkable against domain facts, the video's own metadata, or a third provider's corroboration). References are always verbatim provider output, chosen not edited. Adjudication was performed by an LLM (Claude) from the hypothesis texts and context; it is NOT independent human transcription from audio. Every override logs its rationale below.
